harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 (Alpine 3.23) via a persistent sysctl.d drop-in, applied it live, and verified it survives a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Captured pre-change sysctl values and confirmed no prior config for these settings existed
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf setting net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0, applied with sysctl -p
Discovered kernel OR-semantics for accept_redirects require explicit per-existing-interface (eth0, lo) zeroing in addition to all/default; added those entries and reapplied
Verified sysctl 'boot' OpenRC service is enabled, meaning sysctl.d configs apply before networking at boot
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline, triggered a native reboot via sudo -n reboot (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect), polled until node1 was reachable again

Verified post-restart boot_id changed (proving an actual reboot, not just a service restart) and re-verified accept_redirects/accept_source_route are 0 on all, default, eth0, and lo without any manual reapplication, confirming true persistence

evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-change state on node1 (boot id, current sysctl values, no prior config)
evidence.summary: Captured initial boot_id 181ad286... and pre-change values: accept_redirects default=1 (all=0), accept_source_route default=1 (all=0); no existing sysctl.d entries for these keys

evidence.requirement: Persistent config written and live values set to 0 for all/default
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl -p; all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed 0, but eth0/lo still showed 1 due to kernel OR-logic for accept_redirects

evidence.requirement: Full persistent disablement across all interfaces including pre-existing eth0/lo
evidence.summary: Extended sysctl.d file with explicit eth0/lo entries, reapplied; verified every interface (all, default, eth0, lo) reports accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0

evidence.requirement: Confirm the sysctl.d drop-in is actually loaded at boot time (persistence mechanism)
evidence.summary: Confirmed OpenRC 'sysctl' service is enabled in the 'boot' runlevel, which applies /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf before networking starts

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline snapshot immediately before reboot
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (181ad286...) and confirmed hardening values still 0 across all/default/eth0 immediately before restart

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'sudo -n reboot' via nohup so the exec call acknowledged (pid returned) before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Proof node was actually down / mid-restart
evidence.summary: Multiple connection reset/timeout errors while polling confirm node1 was offline during the reboot
First successful exec after reboot confirms command execution available again on node1

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving a genuine restart occurred, and recovered hardened state without manual reapplication
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is d8031d89... (different from pre-restart 181ad286...), proving an actual reboot; accept_redirects and accept_source_route remain 0 on all/default/eth0/lo, sysctl.d file intact, and OpenRC sysctl service shows 'started' in boot runlevel -- confirming persistent recovery

attempts.summary: Disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 (Alpine 3.23) via a persistent sysctl.d drop-in, applied it live, and verified it survives a full node reboot.
